option.label: Several closely spaced radiating whorls
option.detail: Gould describes 10–20 flexuous/arcuate branches in several close-radiating whorls. Close whorls are not the widely separated tiers of every other windmillgrass.

option.label: UPPER sterile floret inflated, margins rolled inward
option.detail: Open one spikelet: the sterile floret above the fertile one is markedly inflated, with upper margins inrolled. This is the hood; not a glume or the fertile lemma.

option.label: UPPER sterile floret awn absent or up to 1.5 mm
option.detail: Locate the UPPER sterile floret. Gould permits it to be awnless or have an awn to1.5 mm; do not assign this absence/interval to the lower fertile lemma.

option.label: LOWER fertile lemma: pressed-down hairs on keel/margins
option.detail: The lower fertile lemma is otherwise hairless, with appressed-pilose keel and margins. These are not glume hairs or a long apical hair crown.

option.label: LOWER fertile lemma broad, elliptic and blunt
option.detail: Gould describes the lower fertile lemma as broadly elliptic, 1.5–2 mm long, obtuse at apex. Keep the inflated upper sterile floret separate.

option.label: Glumes hairless except rough midnerve
option.detail: Inspect both OUTER glumes. Gould calls them glabrous except scabrous midnerve. Mere roughness is not ordinary stiff hairs on the glume back.

option.label: Both glumes present, first shorter
option.detail: First outer glume0.5–0.7 mm and second1–1.5 mm. Both are present; a small first glume is not a missing glume.

exact_glume_hair_absence.note: Gould explicitly describes glumes hairless except rough midnerve. Confirm ordinary stiff/pilose hairs on the actual outer glume, not mere midnerve roughness or hairs on inner lemma. Pure-species account; suspected hybrid intermediates require review.

learner_diagnostic_checks.look: Open the spikelet to find the actual hood
learner_diagnostic_checks.check: The LOWER fertile lemma is broadly elliptic/blunt, with pressed-down hairs on keel/margins and a0.3–1.5 mm awn. The UPPER sterile floret is markedly inflated with inrolled upper margins, awnless or awned to1.5 mm. The hood is not an outer glume.
learner_diagnostic_checks.compare: Short fertile awns overlap KR. Do not use the sterile floret’s awnlessness as universal fertile-lemma absence.
learner_diagnostic_checks.certainty: Exact Gould pp.324–325 with fertile/sterile position scope.

learner_diagnostic_checks.look: Distinguish glume hairs from rough midnerve and lemma hairs

learner_diagnostic_checks.compare: KR’s stiff-haired sessile first-glume back is a different organ observation from hooded’s hairy fertile-lemma keel/margins.
